extensionDescription.message: Ambient light for X and Instagram photos and videos, and Twitch and Kick streams. On phones, X follows the post at screen center.

popupSubtitle.message: Ambient light for X, Instagram, Twitch and Kick.

videoTrackingDescription.message: Update the light as the video plays

fitCardsLabel.message: Fit X cards to window width

fitCardsDescription.message: Adjust photo and video width to the window

hoverHint.message: X and Instagram media. Twitch and Kick streams.

statusReady.message: X details light up automatically; hover over timeline posts or replies. Instagram follows the active post or reel. Twitch and Kick follow the video.

statusReadyMobile.message: X lights up the post at the center of the screen. Instagram follows the active post or reel. Twitch and Kick follow the video.

statusLoadError.message: Unable to load settings. Reopen the extension.

statusSaveError.message: Unable to save changes. Reopen the extension.
